meta.source_kind: legacy PHP form (POST, cp1251); full listing via the 'all' submit field
notes: KATOTTG and hromadas are not published. The operator groups by REM, so the REM is what tells six different Іванівки apart. It is exposed as area/area_kind='rem', NOT written into the hromada field - those are different things.

Addresses exempt from hourly outages ('В цей час не вимикається') ARE included, with an empty queue list: the resident still wants emergency and planned works. An empty list means 'no scheduled outages', not 'unknown'.
House numbers are in the project's canonical form (app/services/house_number).
Rows exist separately for 'побутові' and 'непобутові' consumers; merged here.
